new:
support the \SI{100}{\watt} objective.

Feedback on the APEC digest raised the question of whether the converter
could support higher loads, including \SI{240}{\watt} USB-PD Extended
Power Range (EPR). Assessing higher-power operation first requires the
secondary-winding heating and limited power increase in the tested
high-load range to be resolved.

old:
remain unfinished. The immediate objective is \SI{100}{\watt};
\SI{240}{\watt} EPR remains a longer-term goal.

The longer-term \SI{240}{\watt} USB-PD EPR goal requires adequate pump
charge transfer, switch and capacitor stress margins, rectification,
magnetic current capability, control range, isolation, cooling, and output
hardware. EPR delivery has not been demonstrated.
The 100 W target and longer-term 240 W EPR goal are not continuous ratings.
new: The project target remains 100 W. The question of higher-load operation, including 240 W USB-PD EPR, arose from feedback on the APEC digest.
